scientific_integrity: Universal claims rest on an explicit self-contained proof. The independent program enumerates 5,231 naturally labeled posets of orders at most six and selected larger chain unions as supplementary finite checks. No independent scientific audit or absolute historical-priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonempty posets with all lower ideals and element-membership queries. Individual-poset adaptive rank need not meet the extremal bound, and the structural characterization of maximizers is proved only when height plus one is a power of two. A related result under alternate names may have escaped accessible literature comparisons.
title: Sharp height–width ceiling and dyadic rigidity for online shattering of poset ideals
